pages.title: Qingxin Pill
pages.text: The Qingxin Pill follows pills_catalog.json#qingxin_pill and alchemy_recipes.json#recipe_qingxin_pill. It is integrated with the existing alchemy system: players can obtain its paper formula and refine the pill in an alchemy furnace.

pages.title: Refining Requirements
pages.text: The built-in recipe uses 3 spirit herbs, costs 20 spiritual power, and takes 440 ticks. Its base success rate is 0.65 and furnace-explosion risk is 0.04. It requires a tier-1 furnace, ideally a tier-2 alchemical flame, and can be attempted from Qi Refining onward.

pages.title: Current Implementation
pages.text: The Qingxin Pill currently reuses an existing mind-calming pill effect to fulfill its role in reducing inner-demon risk. A dedicated inner-demon effect, quality variants, and a unique icon remain future improvements.
